defs.ScenPartDef/HH_ScenRules.label: Hearth & Harbor rules
defs.ScenPartDef/HH_ScenRules.description: Sets modules, hosting difficulty, content intensity and any per-colony setting of Hearth & Harbor and Silverline for new colonies of this scenario. Only what is set here overrides the template; the player can still change everything on the storyteller page.
